name: react-native-electrum-client-rs
description: High-performance Electrum client for React Native, powered by Rust

scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm run build:bindings && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:bindings: npm run uniffi:kotlin && npm run uniffi:swift
scripts.uniffi:kotlin: cargo run --bin uniffi-bindgen -- generate src/electrum_client.udl --language kotlin --out-dir android/src/main/java
scripts.uniffi:swift: cargo run --bin uniffi-bindgen -- generate src/electrum_client.udl --language swift --out-dir ios

author: Steven Fusco
